params.caption: 🎮 Subway drops a "Vice City" sub for GTA 6, but you can't eat it Subway is marking the GTA 6 launch with a new Vice City Cubano sandwich. The catch: it only exists inside the game, so fans have to head to Vice City to grab one. It is the latest brand tie-in riding the launch-week hype around Rockstar's game. 🕒 Nov 17, 2026 · 00:01 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Dexerto 👥 @RockstarGames 🥪 Would you order this in-game?
